name: claude_worktree
description: Create a git worktree and launch Claude Code to implement a feature. Call when user says 'create worktree for X', 'new branch for Y', 'claude code work on Z', 'start working on feature X'. The branch name will be auto-generated from the task description.

branch_name.description: Git branch name (kebab-case, e.g., 'add-led-status', 'fix-audio-bug'). Auto-generate from task: convert to lowercase, replace spaces with hyphens, remove special chars.

task_description.description: Clear description of what needs to be implemented. This will be given to Claude Code. Example: 'Add LED status indicator that shows when recording is active' or 'Fix the audio clipping issue in recording.rs'.

workspace.description: Optional Hyprland workspace number (1-10) to open the terminal in. If not specified, opens in current workspace.
